validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real and well-documented. The Saryarka trunk gas pipeline was planned in four phases from a 2017 TEO/2018 project rollout: Phase I Kyzylorda(KS Karaozek)-Zhezkazgan-Karaganda-Temirtau-Astana (1061-1081 km, 267.3 bn KZT, operating since 2019/2020); Phase II Astana-Kokshetau (276 km, 630mm dia, 48.2 bn KZT = GEM's P3307); Phase III Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk (177 km, 426mm dia, 18.9 bn KZT = GEM's P3308); Phase IV = construction of two compressor stations at Zhezkazgan and Temirtau to raise the whole system's throughput, no new pipe (= this row, P3309). This exact 4-phase breakdown, cost, and scope is corroborated by kapital.kz 'Строительство газопровода Сарыарка пройдет в 4 этапа' (2018-12-11, direct quotes from AstanaGaz KMG's capital-construction director) AND independently by neftegaz.ru's technical-library entry (orig. 2018-07-12) AND ru.wikipedia's sourced 'Строительство' section -- three independent write-ups of the same underlying 2018 TEO/PSD, so treated as one origin event but corroborated by outlet-independent reporting. Phase IV's continued reality as of 2025 is separately confirmed by a completely different, much more recent document: Kazakhstan's Order on the Comprehensive Gas Industry Development Plan 2025-2029 (adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/P2500000463, approved 21 June 2025), item 21, which lists 'Реализация 4-го этапа строительства МГ Сарыарка' with a 2027 commissioning target, cost 180.7 bn KZT, and responsible parties Ministry of Energy, Ministry of National Economy, Samruk-Kazyna JSC, QazaqGaz, Intergas Central Asia JSC, and AstanaGaz KMG JSC -- this is a live, dated, government planning document, not GEM-derived, and it independently reconfirms both the project's existence and its updated cost 7 years after the original 35.5 bn KZT estimate. Existence tier: high (2+ fully independent sources, 2018 and 2025, both non-GEM). DUPLICATE check against the roster: P3307 (Phase II, 276 km) and P3308 (Phase III, 177 km) are sibling phases of the same overall Saryarka project but are physically distinct pipe segments from P3309's pure capacity-expansion scope -- not duplicates of each other, correctly split as separate GEM rows. CLASSIFICATION: Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are correct for a national gas trunk line capacity upgrade. ATTRIBUTION: StartLocation='Karaozek' matches the compressor station 'KS Karaozek' in Kyzylorda Region that ru.wikipedia specifically names as the Phase I tie-in point to the Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent pipeline ('участок Кызылорда (от КС «Караозек»)'); EndLocation='Petropavlovsk' matches the terminus of Phase III. Because Phase IV's actual construction sites are Zhezkazgan and Temirtau (mid-route compressor stations, not the pipeline's outer endpoints), the Karaozek->Petropavlovsk pair should be read as the extent of the SYSTEM this capacity expansion benefits, not the physical worksite -- not an error, but worth noting for anyone expecting literal CS coordinates. FuelSource (Karachaganak, Tengiz, Kashagan) is directly supported by its cited kapital.kz source (verified, contains all three field names). Owner1=AstanaGaz KMG JSC 100% is corroborated (see the paired fill below) as the project company that holds the pipeline; Samruk-Kazyna SWF and Baiterek Holding are its parent shareholders (consistent, not conflicting, with GEM's separate Owner field being the direct legal owner). SegmentCost=180,700,000,000 KZT / 2025: the row's existing_ref_check against P2500000463 shows a FALSE FAIL -- the checker looked for the literal digit string '180700000000' but the source states it in Russian financial-document prose as '180,7 млрд тенге' (item 21), which is the exact same figure (180.7 billion tenge = 180,700,000,000 KZT). Confirmed correct on manual read; this is a prose/unit-equivalence miss, not a data problem.

validity.recommendation: Route to Update: either replace Capacity=7.80 bcm/y with the source-stated total-system figure (9-10 bcm/y by 2030 per the gasification scheme) with a note that it is the whole pipeline's design capacity rather than a Phase-IV-only increment, or keep 7.80 but add a ResearcherNotes caveat that it is a computed/derived estimate, not a number stated by any primary source.
validity.researcher_notes: Capacity=7.80 bcm/y is cited to adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/G23JVM00350#z250 (the 2023 General Gasification Scheme). I fetched and full-text-searched that document directly: it contains NO literal '7,8' figure tied to Saryarka (the only '7,8'-substring hits in the whole document are unrelated numbers -- '27,8 млрд м3/год' national gas output, '37,8%' a production share, '527,8' and '7,81' in an unrelated GPP table). What the document DOES say (para 93) is that the whole Saryarka trunk's 'maximum throughput capacity, once all design decisions including construction of two compressor stations are implemented, will be equivalent to about 9-10 billion m3/year' and 'full design capacity of up to 25 million m3/day by 2030' (~9.1 bcm/y) -- a TOTAL-SYSTEM figure, not a Phase-IV-specific increment. Reading gem.wiki's own infobox for the same footnote 16 shows the actual GEM-side text: 'Capacity: 9-10 bcm/year (additional 6.8-7.8 bcm/year)' -- i.e., GEM itself computed the 'additional 6.8-7.8' by subtracting some baseline from the source's stated 9-10 bcm/y range; that subtraction is NOT present in the primary document. The likely mechanics (9 minus 2.2, 10 minus 2.2 = 6.8-7.8) reuse the 2.2 bcm/y capacity GEM separately assigned to Phase II/III (P3307/P3308) as the 'baseline' -- but those are branch-pipe throughput limits for the northern legs, not a physically coherent baseline for the whole trunk's pre-Phase-IV capacity (which is dominated by Phase I's much larger 820mm-diameter pipe). Independent corroboration of the ORIGINAL 2018 target instead points to a much lower number: kapital.kz and neftegaz.ru both state Phase IV's original goal was to raise the pipeline's capacity 'до 3 млрд куб. м/год' (to 3 bcm/y total), for 35.5 bn KZT -- a figure that has since been superseded on cost (180.7 bn KZT per the 2025 Complex Plan) but no source I found gives an updated capacity number to go with the updated cost. Net: 7.80 bcm/y is neither stated in the cited primary source nor independently corroborated as a discrete figure by any other source -- it is GEM's own derived estimate presented as a sourced fact. This is a genuine unsupported/derived-spec finding, not a fabrication-level problem (the true total-system capacity target, 9-10 bcm/y, is real and well documented), but the specific point value in the Capacity cell should not be treated as source-verified.

fills.researcher_notes: The Phase IV compressor-station concept (Zhezkazgan + Temirtau CS, then costed at 35.5 bn KZT to raise capacity to 3 bcm/y) is first documented in Kazakhstan's original 2017-2018 Saryarka TEO/PSD rollout. kapital.kz (2018-12-11, direct quotes from AstanaGaz KMG's capital-construction director) and neftegaz.ru's tech-library entry (orig. 2018-07-12) both lay out all four phases including Phase IV -- two independently written outlets describing the same original 2018 plan, matching the sheet's ProposalYear=2018.

Both sources describe Phase IV as the construction of two compressor stations only ('строительство компрессорных станций «Жезказган» и «Темиртау»') to raise the existing pipeline's throughput -- no new pipe route or length is part of this phase's scope, confirming LengthKnown=0.00 is correct (a capacity expansion on existing pipe, matching the row's RouteType='Capacity expansion only').

kapital.kz (2018) describes AstanaGaz KMG JSC as the project company ('проектная компания АО «АстанаГаз КМГ»') whose charter capital was funded 50/50 by Samruk-Kazyna and Baiterek -- i.e. AstanaGaz KMG is the direct owning entity, with Samruk-Kazyna/Baiterek as indirect parent shareholders (consistent with a separate ParentCompany field, not a conflict). Independently, the 2025 Complex Plan (adilet P2500000463, item 21) names 'АО «АстанаГаз КМГ»' among the parties responsible for delivering Phase IV. Two independent, differently-dated sources (2018, 2025) support Owner1=AstanaGaz KMG JSC 100%.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Newest dated evidence found: Kazakhstan's Order approving the Comprehensive Plan for Gas Industry Development 2025-2029 (adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/P2500000463, approved 21 June 2025). Item 21, 'Реализация 4-го этапа строительства МГ Сарыарка', lists the responsible parties (Ministry of Energy, Ministry of National Economy, Samruk-Kazyna, QazaqGaz, Intergas Central Asia, AstanaGaz KMG), a 2027 commissioning target, an updated cost of 180.7 bn KZT, and -- critically for status -- a financing source explicitly marked 'подлежит определению' (yet to be determined). Financing not yet secured as of mid-2025 is consistent with Status=proposed, not construction. I searched for any 2026 update (news searches for Zhezkazgan/Temirtau compressor-station construction start, financing decisions, KazMunayGas/AstanaGaz KMG announcements) and found nothing dated later than the June 2025 plan; the only 2025-2026 Saryarka-adjacent construction news I found (kursiv.media, Nov 2024) is an unrelated private lateral/offtake project (Kazakhmys Energy's gas branch to Zhezkazgan CHP, tapping the Saryarka trunk at km 373.9), not the Phase IV compressor stations. StartYear1=2027 matches the plan's commissioning year exactly. Since the most recent confirming evidence (June 2025, ~14 months old) is well under the 2-year dormancy threshold for a proposed project, and it is a live government planning instrument (not a stale announcement), Status=proposed and StartYear1=2027 are both confirmed as still correct; no change proposed.

summary: P3309 (Saryarka Phase IV, capacity-expansion-only) is real and correctly classified/attributed -- corroborated by 2018 original-plan reporting plus an independent, much newer 2025 government Complex Plan document that reconfirms the project and updates its cost to 180.7 bn KZT (the sheet's SegmentCost figure checks out on manual read despite a false-negative from the automated verifier); filled the three missing refs (ProposalYear=2018, LengthKnown=0, Owner1=AstanaGaz KMG 100%) and confirmed Status=proposed/StartYear1=2027 as still current per the June 2025 plan. One flagged spec concern: Capacity=7.80 bcm/y is not stated by any primary source I could find -- it appears to be GEM's own derived 'additional capacity' estimate (per gem.wiki's own infobox range '6.8-7.8 bcm/year') computed from the gasification scheme's total-system 9-10 bcm/y figure, not a number the source states for Phase IV specifically; routed to Update for a sourcing decision.
